en.tech_products: GSK plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, and manufacture of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines to prevent and treat disease in the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Commercial Operations and Total R&D segments. The company offers specialty medicines that include oncology, respiratory/immunology, inflammation, and inhaled medicines for HIV, respiratory eosinophildriven diseases, lupus and lupus nephritis, ovarian cancer, and endometrial cancer.
en.moat: GSK plc benefits from its established presence in Drug Manufacturers - General and brand recognition.
en.risks: As a Drug Manufacturers - General company, GSK plc is exposed to competitive pressure, regulatory changes in its operating regions, macroeconomic cycles, and shifts in consumer or enterprise demand affecting its core segments.
